thread:
nina_cs: CedarView reported repeated 502/504s from EU during an investor demo at 10:05 UTC. They asked for a short-term EU edge and a transient qps uplift to avoid demo failure. Renewal check in 12 days, they said perf will factor into renewal.

marco_se: Any traffic numbers? endpoints?

nina_cs: Mostly /v1/chat and streaming. Saw ~110 rps sustained for 7m with spikes to 250rps. Errors look like timeouts from eu cluster. They asked for "eu-edge + 1.7x qps" for 24h starting today 11:00 UTC.

juhi_netops: We can enable eu-west-1-edge and add their CIDRs to allowlist. Need CIDRs and exact window. Recommend ACL with auto-revoke at +24h.

nina_cs: CIDRs: 203.119.45.0/24, 77.88.10.128/26. Window 11:00 UTC today -> +24h.

juhi_netops: Creating ACL "cedarview-demo-5187" -> acl-10177, will apply to eu-west-1-edge and set revoke at +24h.

marco_se: For safety, push per-route qps override for their API token route instead of account-wide change. I'll set route override x1.7 and pin to burst pool.

rachel_infra: I'll provision a tiny burst pool in eu-west-1 (1x A10g equiv) tagged cedarview-burst-5187. Opening INC-4599 and tagging eng-sre for monitoring.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-4599 "CedarView demo: eu edge allowlist + route qps uplift" by rachel_infra. ETA: 60m.

nina_cs: Please add renewal note: client said demo performance will influence renewal. Set renewal_risk: medium.

juhi_netops: ACL applied, rule id acl-10177. Please confirm customer test.

nina_cs: Sent curl example and scheduled smoke at 11:05 UTC.

nina_cs: curl sample:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer $CEDAR_TOKEN" -d '{"model":"gptx-lite","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}]}'
```

marco_se: Monitoring traces + token latency. If errors persist we have fallback to hosted-eu-replica and can throttle bursts.

rachel_infra: Burst node up, route override pushed, auto-revoke scheduled at +24h. Closing loop after demo. :white_check_mark:

nina_cs: Thanks all. I'll capture post-demo feedback and update renewal tracker. :memo:
